tuningLog.title: Eliminated odds-on selections
tuningLog.description: Individual picks must be at least evens (1/1). This is an explicit selection-price rule, not a proven accuracy gain.
tuningLog.evidenceStatus: Rule change implemented; improved predictive accuracy not yet demonstrated

tuningLog.title: Expanded the midshot research band
tuningLog.description: Screened 6/1–18/1 runners for recent form, class, pace, ratings and each-way terms rather than selecting on a long price alone.
tuningLog.evidenceStatus: Rule change implemented; improved predictive accuracy not yet demonstrated

tuningLog.title: Raised the Lucky 15 price floor
tuningLog.description: Four distinct-race legs must each be priced strictly above 11/2. Removed shorter legs and excluded reported non-runners.
tuningLog.evidenceStatus: Rule change implemented; improved predictive accuracy not yet demonstrated

tuningLog.title: Reduced speculative longshots
tuningLog.description: Capped the 20/1+ category at one conditional place-oriented runner to concentrate the shortlist.
tuningLog.evidenceStatus: Rule change implemented; improved predictive accuracy not yet demonstrated

tuningLog.title: Added a repeatable pre-race checklist
tuningLog.description: Checks now document going, race grade/value, OR/TS/RPR, draw/pace, jockey, recent form, market and available trainer records. Not all factors were verifiable for every runner.
tuningLog.evidenceStatus: Rule change implemented; improved predictive accuracy not yet demonstrated

tuningLog.title: Identified unverified inputs
tuningLog.description: Full historical trainer/course splits and all-runner sectionals remain incomplete. Confidence labels are qualitative, not calibrated probabilities.
tuningLog.evidenceStatus: Rule change implemented; improved predictive accuracy not yet demonstrated
